beginner.stem: Which story title belongs to Osmium in this catalog?

beginner.stem: Which story title belongs to Osmium in this catalog?
beginner.explanation: The name comes from a Greek word for smell, because a volatile oxide announced the new metal to the nose as soon as it formed.

options: An Oxide Treated as a Warning

beginner.stem: Which story title belongs to Osmium in this catalog?

beginner.explanation: Two neighboring metals are so close in density that the ranking depends on the measurement, though one of them usually wears the crown.
